PHYSICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Temperature and Thermal Expansion? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Temperature and Thermal Expansion.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Waves? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Waves.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Waves.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Waves.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pressure? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pressure.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pressure.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pressure.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Pressure.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Physics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Physics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Physics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Physics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy, Work, Power and Machines? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy, Work, Power and Machines.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Moments and equilibrium? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Moments and equilibrium.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Moments and equilibrium.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Moments and equilibrium.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Moments and equilibrium.

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

17. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

18. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Electronics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Electronics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Electronics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Electronics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Electronics.

21. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Physics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Pressure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
